patterns: APPSC asks direct one-liners: which range has Kashmir/Kangra/Kullu valleys (Himachal), Shiwalik valleys = Duns, Lakshadweep capital Kavaratti, Barren = volcanic, Luni in Indian desert.
Recurring facts: Sahyadri passes Bhorghat/Thalghat (vs Goran ghat trap), Satpura between Narmada-Tapi, Malwa in W MP + SE Rajasthan, Peninsular Plateau rich in metallic minerals, Ooty in Nilgiris.
APPSC 2022 Group-IV style uses simple match-the-following and 'select all that apply' statement items with obvious distractors (Sahara in India).
Other PSCs favour Ghats meeting point (Nilgiri), Anaimudi highest in South India, Dandakaranya states, Chota Nagpur minerals.

App MCQs are far more statement-heavy and dense (Deccan Trap thickness, structural thrust order, 2023-24 coastline remeasurement) than APPSC's direct style; AP angle (Eastern Ghats in AP, Arma Konda) is well covered.
